items.title: Scaling Regulated AI with Domino on Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
items.summary: AI growth in regulated environments put pressure on the systems that govern your data. You need to give teams timely access to approved datasets without losing control of data placement, lineage, or reproducibility. In this post, we share three data architecture principles, show how Domino Data Lab applies them with Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, and give you workload-level metrics to evaluate the architecture.
items.creator: Ben Lin
